package.name: qmini_imu
package.description: Native C++ driver for the Wheeltec N100 (FDILink protocol) IMU. Parses the serial frame stream over a raw termios port (no external serial dep) and publishes sensor_msgs/Imu on /imu/data. Kept in its own process so a stalled IMU port can never block the motor bus. Frame alignment to base_link is verified/fixed in M4 calibration.
